evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallet.h` to suppress wallet rebroadcast and mempool resubmission.
rationale: Prevents the wallet from undermining user privacy by automatically resubmitting dropped unconfirmed transactions when `-privatebroadcast` is active. The description notes this prevents scenarios where 'an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet' compromises wallet privacy.
